description: Enhance Curriculum.jsx: add AI action buttons per indicator when a StandardCard is expanded, a slide-up drawer for AI responses. Depends on FEAT-001 (subjects array from curriculumData.js) and FEAT-002 (src/services/ai.js).
steps: 1. READ src/pages/Curriculum.jsx in full before touching it.
2. READ src/services/ai.js to confirm the four function signatures and what they return.

3. MODIFY src/pages/Curriculum.jsx:

   a. Add to imports:
      import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
      import { generateLessonPlan, generateActivities, generateAssessment, explainIndicator } from '../services/ai';

   b. Add AIDrawer component (defined in the same file, above the StandardCard component):
      - Props: { open, onClose, title, content, loading, error }
      - Renders a slide-up drawer: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col bg-card rounded-t-2xl border-t border-line shadow-xl.
      - Transition: translate-y-full when closed, translate-y-0 when open (CSS transition transition-transform duration-300 ease-in-out).
      - Also render a backdrop: when open, fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-black/40 (clicking backdrop calls onClose).
      - Handle element is a 40px wide 4px tall rounded bar centered at top of the drawer.
      - Header: title on left, X close button on right (using lucide-react X icon).
      - Body (overflow-y-auto flex-1 px-4 pb-4):
          - Loading state: centered Loader2 spin (animate-spin) with 'Generating…' text.
          - Error state: text-red-500 text-sm showing error message.
          - Content: render as <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm text-ink leading-relaxed"> so newlines are preserved.
      - Footer: Copy button (copies content to clipboard via navigator.clipboard.writeText), Close button. Both use design tokens. Copy button shows 'Copied!' for 2 seconds then reverts.
acceptance_criteria: Each indicator in an expanded StandardCard shows 4 action buttons (Generate Lesson, Generate Activities, Generate Assessment, Explain).
Clicking any button opens the drawer with a spinner and the appropriate title.
On success, the drawer shows formatted text content and a Copy button.
Copy button writes text to clipboard and shows 'Copied!' momentarily.
After a successful Generate Lesson, a 'Plan this in Planner →' button appears in the drawer footer.
Clicking 'Plan this in Planner →' navigates to /planner.
Drawer closes on backdrop click or X button.
npm run build passes with zero errors.
verification: npm run build  (must complete without errors)
